patches.name: Hide Pay Later navigation tab
patches.description: Prevents Pay Later from taking the fourth navigation slot without disabling its payment services.

patches.name: Hide Pay Later secondary price
patches.description: Hides the Pay Later secondary price on discovery listings without changing the primary price or checkout.

patches.name: Hide bottom navigation tabs
patches.description: Adds optional toggles to remove Categories, Mall and Video Finds from the bottom tab bar.

patches.name: Hide loan and Pay Later profile entries
patches.description: Removes the three finance entries from the account list without changing repayment or checkout.

patches.name: Hide reel cards in feeds
patches.description: Removes reel-format catalog cards from discovery feeds while leaving the video tab untouched.

patches.name: Hide search recommendation trays
patches.description: Removes the Gold Premium Quality and You may also like rows from search, and Similar Products rows from search, category pages and the home feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored listings and order ads
patches.description: Removes active sponsored product records, two identified My Orders finance banners and the Wishlist Pay Later banner, and disables configured order ads.

patches.name: Product ratings only
patches.description: Removes supplier review summaries and supplier-typed catalog ratings. Missing product ratings stay missing.

patches.name: Sort loaded search results by rating count
patches.description: Adds a button to sort currently loaded search and category products by product rating count.

patches.name: Sort search pages by rating count
patches.description: Sorts each returned search page by product rating count, highest first. Does not globally reorder unloaded pages.

release_notes:
First release of Window Shopper, with Meesho patches (29.9 / 30.0):

- Hide sponsored products, ads and finance promotions (Pay Later, loans)
- Show product ratings instead of shop ratings
- Sort search and category results by number of ratings
- Hide feed reels, search trays and optional bottom tabs
- Profile → Morphe settings page to toggle each feature

Signed with `morphe-signing.pub`.
